subject: Request: Short-term evaluation credit while procurement is in purchasing freeze
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@helixhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix Health Purchasing <purchasing@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — procurement pause

Hi Sean,

Quick update from our side — procurement has put a hold on new SaaS spend while they renegotiate our vendor master agreement. Legal is involved and it could be 3–4 weeks before a PO can be issued. We still want to complete the integration work and validate latency/cost on real traffic, but the team will run out of sandbox credits in ~10 days.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short-term credit or temporary extension so we can finish validation while the PO is in flight? We can sign a short written acknowledgement that a PO is forthcoming and that credits convert to billed usage once the PO clears.

Appreciate any flexibility — Samira
Samira Patel
Director, Applied ML
Helix Health
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — procurement pause

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads-up and for the clear ask. We want to keep your integration momentum going.

Short answer: yes, we can provision a temporary evaluation credit while your PO is under review. Before I commit to amounts I need to confirm a couple of operational details:
- Approximate token/day you expect during the next 2–3 weeks (so we size the credit correctly).
- A point of contact for PO follow-up (who from purchasing/legal we can send invoice/status to).
- Whether Helix needs an independent acknowledgment doc (we can provide a 30-day bridging credit agreement).

If you want, I can loop in our sales ops lead to approve a one-time bridging credit and generate the voucher PDF. Otherwise I can issue a short-term grant from my mailbox for up to $2,500 equivalent service credits.

We can do a 30-day credit that expires if the PO doesn't arrive in that window. Let me know token estimate and I'll get the voucher started today.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood trial — procurement pause 

Forwarding the request from Helix Health — they have a purchasing freeze and asked for a short-term credit so they can finish validation. Context: mid-market health org, clear buy intent, deal id HLX-4592, expected PO but legal is slowing to renegotiate terms.

My proposed motion: approve a one-off $2,500 evaluation credit (30 days) and generate a voucher that requires PO reference when invoiced. If we want to be conservative we can do $1,500.

Can Marissa/Monica sign off on the amount? Dev — FYI for the voucher/template and to note in billing so credits map to deal HLX-4592.

Thanks — Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood trial — procurement pause

Thanks for the context, Sean. I approve a temporary credit of $2,000 (midpoint) for Helix Health, valid for 30 days from issuance. Conditions:
- Credit converts to billed usage against HLX-4592 once a PO is received; accounting will reconcile against PO number.
- Customer must provide a PO reference within 30 days; if none is received the remaining balance will be forfeited (we'll mark as promotional credit).
- We require a one-paragraph acknowledgement from the customer confirming purchase intent (Samira suggested this).

Dev — please generate the voucher PDF with HLX-4592 on the header, and add a one-paragraph text block for customer acknowledgment. Monica — please ensure CS is aware of the credit and tags the account for a renewal/expansion play if the PO drops.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Helix Health Purchasing <purchasing@helixhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: 30-day evaluation credit for Helix Health (HLX-4592)

Samira — good news. We've approved a temporary evaluation credit for Helix Health. Summary below and attached voucher.

- Amount: $2,000 of Redwood evaluation credits
- Validity: 30 days from issuance (expires 2026-08-20)
- Conditions: Credits convert to billed usage against deal HLX-4592 upon receipt of PO. Customer to provide PO reference within 30 days; otherwise remaining credit is promotional and will not be billed.

Attached: helix_voucher_20260719.pdf (voucher with PO reference field and one-paragraph acknowledgement text). Please reply to this thread with the expected token/day estimate and loop in purchasing's PO contact for invoicing.

If purchasing wants a short statement of intent we can accept a one-paragraph email and attach it to the deal record.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing the integration progress.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: helix_voucher_20260719.pdf (pdf stub)
